notes.title: An epilogue and some future plans
notes.content:
[p]Thank you so much for reading The Seabed's Shining Star. [/p][p][/p][p]We are currently working on our second visual novel, which will be released next year. 
More information about it will be available near the end of 2025. [/p][p][/p][p]In the mean time, we just published a short epilogue for The Seabed's Shining Star, 
taking place a year after the events of the story. You can read it for free on our [url="https://otsukiyaki.nekoweb.org/NagashiSomen.html"]website[/url].[/p][p][/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352941/73353f2c11c4d89e7a2d25c9982148b4a6f43648.png"][/img][/h1][h1][url="https://otsukiyaki.nekoweb.org/NagashiSomen.html" style="button" buttoncolor="#4d6c4b"]Nagashi Somen: An epilogue to The Seabed's Shining Star[/url][/h1][p][/p][p]In general, we are hoping to make more shortform work for the website, 
so that we can remind you of our existence between bigger projects. [/p][p][/p][p]Feel free to follow us on [url="https://x.com/OTSUKIYAKI/"]Twitter[/url] and [url="https://bsky.app/profile/otsukiyaki.bsky.social"]Bluesky[/url] to stay up to date with our future activities.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support, and we will meet again before long.[/p]
